summary: Upgrades the login library better-auth from 1.6 to 1.7.14 and adds a nullable session.impersonatedBy column (migration) because 1.7 checks the schema at startup and blocks every /api/auth request if a column its plugins (here the admin plugin in lib/auth.ts) write is missing; adds a docs note.

statements.text: Nothing flagged (plain reads logins, payments, database changes and secrets. It doesn't run the code, and it can miss bugs.)
statements.why: Additive nullable column plus a dependency upgrade; the migration-ordering risk is covered by step 1.

statements.text: Sessions now also store the impersonated by.
statements.why: Session.impersonatedBy String? + ALTER TABLE "session" ADD COLUMN "impersonatedBy" TEXT. Awkward wording but true.
Adds the developer note about better-auth 1.7's schema check.

statements.text: Apply prisma/migrations/20261029000000_session_impersonated_by to your live database before the new code goes live (`npx prisma migrate deploy`), or logging in can fail for everyone, not just the new parts: your login library loads sessions, and Prisma asks for every column.
statements.why: Outcome now matches the docs note (auth-permissions.mdx: missing column -> every /api/auth/* request fails). The stated mechanism differs from the documented one (better-auth 1.7 startup schema check), but Prisma's default select of all columns would also fail; the owner takeaway is correct.

statements.text: Test anything that uses better-auth: it was upgraded from ^1.6.22 to ^1.7.14.
statements.why: package.json bump; better-auth handles all login/sessions.
